cases.title: reports exited only once taskkill succeeds
cases.reason: Only successful taskkill close proves tree exit; before that verdict is live and root fallback is forbidden.
cases.final_title: reports exited only once taskkill succeeds

cases.title: keeps one taskkill running past the wait and lets later requests join it
cases.reason: Caller wait expiry preserves one helper per child handle; retry joins, late close verifies, and proven handles are never walked again even if PID is reissued.
cases.final_title: keeps one taskkill running past the wait and lets later requests join it

cases.title: reports %s as unverifiable, kills the root, and allows a retry
cases.reason: Both failed close and asynchronous spawn error report unverifiable, invoke root fallback once and permit a new helper attempt.
cases.final_title: reports %s as unverifiable, kills the root, and allows a retry

cases.title: reports a launch that throws as unverifiable

cases.final_title: reports a launch that throws as unverifiable

cases.title: abandons a wedged taskkill at the deadline, then kills the root
cases.reason: Absolute deadline has a before/at boundary, abandons helper and root once, and ignores a late successful close.
cases.final_title: abandons a wedged taskkill at the deadline, then kills the root

cases.title: still proves a tree when taskkill finishes soon after killing the root
cases.reason: Taskkill success just before root-exit grace expiry can still prove the complete tree; this is a necessary positive control to abandonment.
cases.final_title: still proves a tree when taskkill finishes soon after killing the root

cases.title: abandons taskkill once the root has been gone long enough for its pid to be reissued
cases.reason: Expired root-exit grace abandons a helper before a released PID can be walked later.
cases.final_title: abandons taskkill once the root has been gone long enough for its pid to be reissued

cases.title: never joins two children that share a reused pid
cases.reason: Distinct child handles with reused numeric PID start distinct helpers; identity assertions elsewhere protect handle-keyed ownership.
cases.final_title: never joins two children that share a reused pid

cases.title: restores normal priority for a background helper at %i
